```bash
hexdump -n 16 -e '16/1 "%02x" "\n"' filename
```

This command will:
- `-n 16`: Read only the first 16 bytes

- `-p`: Output in plain hexdump style

- `tr -d '\n'`: Remove any newlines to get a continuous string

```bash
head -c 16 filename | hexdump -ve '1/1 "%02x"'

- `head -c 16`: Extract the first 16 bytes
